title: Real-Block-Cipher Security Reduction for XHX2
summary: XHX2 is analyzed using independently keyed permutations; establishing a real-block-cipher reduction with secure related-key and known-/chosen-key behavior remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Establish a real-block-cipher security reduction for XHX2 under related-key and known-/chosen-key-secure key schedules.

scope.domain: Security reductions for XHX2 instantiated with real block ciphers and their key schedules.
assumptions: The underlying block-cipher key schedule is secure against related-key and known-/chosen-key distinguishing attacks.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish a security reduction for XHX2 instantiated with a real block cipher under the stated key-schedule security conditions.

citations.label: Tweakable Block Ciphers Secure Beyond the Birthday Bound in the Ideal Cipher Model

progress.summary: The source presents this as a practical key-schedule requirement arising from a model in which every block-cipher key defines an independent permutation, rather than as a formally labeled open problem.
citation_labels: ByeongHak Lee et al., Tweakable Block Ciphers Secure Beyond the Birthday Bound in the Ideal Cipher Model
